paragraphs: Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. ("Pursuit") is a global attractions and hospitality company that owns and operates a collection of inspiring and unforgettable travel experiences in iconic destinations in the United States ("U.S."), Canada, Iceland and Costa Rica. Our elevated hospitality experiences include 17 world-class point-of-interest sightseeing attractions and 29 distinctive lodges, along with integrated food and beverage, retail and transportation offerings that enable visitors to discover and connect with stunning national parks and renowned global travel locations. Our company has a strategic direction to expand and elevate our portfolio of extraordinary experiences through a focus on refreshing, improving, and growing our collection of unforgettable, inspiring experiences in iconic places around the globe. We draw our guests from major markets, including the U.S., Canada, Asia Pacific, Western Europe, and Central America.

We are managed on a consolidated basis for purposes of assessing performance and making operating decisions. Accordingly, we are deemed to be a single operating segment in this Form 10-K. See Note 19 – Segment Information to the Consolidated Financial Statements (Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K) for additional information.
The experiences that we offer are grouped and marketed as "collections" based on geographic region. The information provided below describes our collections and the experiences offered.

We own and operate attractions and hospitality experiences in the Canadian Rockies. Highlights include scenic lake cruises in Banff and Jasper National Parks, top-of-the-mountain views from the Banff Gondola, glacier explorations at the Columbia Icefield with the Columbia Icefield Adventure and the Columbia Icefield Skywalk, the Golden SkyBridge over deep canyons, and an aerial tramway with the Jasper SkyTram. Visitors can also enjoy culinary destinations, retail offerings, and hotel experiences throughout Banff, Jasper and Waterton Lakes National Park. The collection is further complemented by a sightseeing tour experience and transportation portfolio.

We own and operate attractions and hospitality experiences including wildlife viewing, whale watching, and glacier cruises, in addition to iconic lodging in and around Denali and Kenai Fjords National Parks and the town of Talkeetna. From the port towns of Seward and Talkeetna, to the end of the road in Denali National Park, we offer a collection of iconic attractions and hotels, complemented by culinary and retail offerings.

We own and operate attractions and hospitality experiences in and around Glacier National Park. Experiences include guided fishing and river rafting tours, lodging, and culinary and retail offerings, all designed to enable guests to experience Montana's stunning mountain vistas. Accommodations include historic lodges built by the Great Northern Railroad, to tiny homes and glamping cabins at the edge of the Glacier National Park to an RV campground and motels.

Flyover is an immersive experience of awe and wonder, transporting guests through the world's most epic places through exhilarating flying journeys. The attraction utilizes flight motion seats engineered to swoop, dip and turn, giving guests a feeling of flight while a 65-foot spherical screen provides guests with an unparalleled flight across iconic locations and natural landscapes. Special effects, including wind, mist and scents, create an unforgettable entertainment experience. On January 21, 2026, Pursuit entered into a definitive agreement to sell all of its Flyover attractions (the "Flyover Attractions") to Brogent Technologies Inc. ("Brogent") for approximately $78.4 million in cash, subject to post-closing adjustments (the "Flyover Attractions Sale"). See Note 21 – Subsequent Event to the Consolidated Financial Statements (Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K) for additional information.

Sky Lagoon, Iceland's stunning oceanfront geothermal lagoon takes guests on a wellness journey rooted in Icelandic heritage through its Skjól Ritual experience. Located in Kársnes Harbour, Kópavogur, just minutes from Reykjavík, Sky Lagoon features a 70-meter (230 ft) infinity-edge lagoon highlighted by awe-inspiring sunsets, Northern Lights and dark sky views. Additionally, the expanded Skjól Ritual and Turf House opened in 2024.

Tabacón Thermal Resort & Spa ("Tabacón") is an eco-luxury resort spanning 570 acres of rainforest which features two thermal river attractions, located in the Arenal region of Costa Rica. Tabacón features 105 rooms, an internationally renowned spa, and signature culinary experiences. Tabacón's two thermal river attractions offer protected access to naturally flowing hot springs. Set against a lush backdrop, the resort's winding rivers, cascading waterfalls and thoughtfully designed pools deliver a tranquil, immersive wellness experience.

Our collection of experiences focuses on three distinct lines of business: Attractions (including food and beverage services and retail operations); Hospitality (including food and beverage services and retail operations); and Transportation.

Banff Gondola transports visitors to an elevation of over 7,000 feet above sea level to the top of Sulphur Mountain in Banff, Alberta, Canada offering an unobstructed view of the Canadian Rockies and overlooking the town of Banff and Bow Valley. The Banff Gondola was a 2025 Trip Advisor Travelers' Choice award winner. The Sky Bistro restaurant, which is located at the top of the Banff Gondola, was rated in the top 100 restaurants in Canada by OpenTable in 2024.

Lake Minnewanka Cruise provides guests a unique sightseeing experience through interpretive boat cruises on Lake Minnewanka in the Canadian Rockies. The Lake Minnewanka Cruise operations are located adjacent to the town of Banff and include boat tours, small boat rentals, and charter fishing expeditions. The Lake Minnewanka Cruise was a 2025 Trip Advisor Travelers' Choice award winner.

Columbia Icefield Adventure and Ice Odyssey Experience is a tour of the Athabasca Glacier on the Columbia Icefield, which provides guests a view of one of the largest accumulations of ice and snow south of the Arctic Circle. Guests ride in giant "Ice Explorers," a unique vehicle specially designed for glacier travel, along with a smaller, more intimate Ice Odyssey experience. The Columbia Icefield Adventure was a 2025 Trip Advisor Travelers' Choice award winner.

Columbia Icefield Skywalk is a 1,312-foot guided interpretive walkway with a 98-foot glass-floored observation area overlooking the Sunwapta Valley, near our Columbia Icefield Adventure attraction in Jasper National Park, Alberta, Canada.

headings: Risks Related to our Business and Industry
Risks Related to Ownership of our Common Stock
paragraphs: Our operations and financial results are subject to known and unknown risks. As a result, past financial performance and historical trends may not be reliable indicators of our future performance.

We are vulnerable to deterioration in general economic conditions and geopolitical uncertainty. Our business is particularly sensitive to fluctuations in general economic conditions in the U.S. and other global markets in which we operate. A decline in global or regional economic conditions, or consumers' fears that economic conditions will decline, whether due to fluctuations in inflation, interest rates, currency exchange rates, or other economic or geopolitical uncertainties, travel disruptions, pandemics, employment and unemployment rates, fluctuations in stock markets, the impacts of trade policies including tariffs, contraction of credit availability, or other dynamic factors, could cause a decline in consumer spending, in particular on leisure travel and related attractions. Consumer preferences tend to shift to lower-cost alternatives during periods of economic recession and other periods in which disposable income is adversely affected which could result in lower revenue from reduced discretionary spending by guests on leisure travel. Additionally, during periods of high inflation and associated elevated interest rates, our operating expenses and interest expense on our variable rate debt will increase. Additional impacts of these macroeconomic developments on our operations cannot be predicted with certainty and deterioration in general economic conditions could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.

The seasonality of our business makes us particularly sensitive to adverse events during peak periods. The peak activity for our business is during the summer months, as the vast majority of our revenue is earned in the second and third quarters. If adverse events or conditions occur during these peak periods, including natural disasters such as wildfires, hurricanes, or volcanic eruptions, or similar events which render our properties unusable or otherwise deter traffic to locations where our properties are situated, our results of operations could be materially and adversely affected. For example, on July 22, 2024, Jasper National Park was closed and evacuated due to wildfire activity. This incident had a negative effect on visitation to our lodging properties in Jasper National Park as well as the Maligne Lake Cruise and the Columbia Icefield attractions (including the Columbia Icefield Adventure and Columbia Icefield Skywalk) during the peak 2024 tourist season in Jasper National Park.

We operate in a highly competitive and dynamic industry. Competition in the attractions and hospitality industry is driven by price and service quality, among other factors. We may be impacted by increases in capacity in the hospitality industry, which may result in capacity growth beyond demand, either globally or for a region, or for a particular itinerary. We compete for guests at our hotels and for customers of our attractions, based primarily on brand name recognition and reputation, location, customer satisfaction, attraction and room rates, quality of service, amenities, quality of accommodations, security, our cancellation policy, and access to preferred-rate hotel inventory. Some of our competitors also have greater financial and marketing resources than we do, which could allow them to reduce their rates, offer greater convenience, services or amenities, build new hotels in direct competition with our existing hotels, improve their properties or expand and improve their marketing efforts, all of which could adversely affect the ability of our hotels to attract prospective guests and materially and adversely affect our revenues and profitability as well as limit or slow our future growth. To the extent competitors seek to gain or retain market presence, including through aggressive underpricing strategies, we may be required to lower our prices and rates to avoid the loss of related business. If we are unable to anticipate and respond as effectively as our competitors to changing business conditions, including new technologies and business models, we could lose market share and/or our results of operations could be materially and adversely affected.

Furthermore, our success depends on the strength and continued development of our brand and the effectiveness of our brand strategies. Failure to protect or differentiate our brand from our competitors throughout the attractions and hospitality industry or our inability to meet the challenges presented by the competitive and dynamic environment of our industry could materially and adversely affect our results of operations. Our results of operations may also be adversely affected if we fail to provide satisfactory customer service.

We also, at times, compete for acquisitions with others, which could limit the number of suitable investment opportunities and/or increase the bargaining power of property owners seeking to sell to us, making it more difficult for us to acquire new properties on attractive terms or on the terms contemplated in our business strategy.

headings: Goodwill, Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, and Long-Lived Assets
paragraphs: On January 21, 2026, Pursuit entered into a definitive agreement to sell all of its Flyover Attractions (the "Flyover Attractions") to Brogent Technologies Inc. ("Brogent") for approximately $78.4 million in cash, subject to customary post-closing adjustments (the "Flyover Attractions Sale"). See Note 21 – Subsequent Event to the Consolidated Financial Statements (Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K) for additional information.

On July 1, 2025, we entered into the "Tabacón Purchase Agreement" with the shareholders of Inversiones Turísticas Arenal, S.A. ("ITA"), pursuant to which we acquired all of the issued and outstanding shares of ITA. ITA is the owner and operator of Tabacón Thermal Resort & Spa ("Tabacón"), an eco-luxury resort spanning 570 acres of rainforest which features two thermal river attractions, located in the Arenal region of Costa Rica. Tabacón features 105 rooms, an internationally renowned spa, and signature culinary experiences. See Note 4 – Acquisitions to the Consolidated Financial Statements (Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K) for additional information. The financial results of Tabacón are consolidated in our financial statements prospectively from the date of acquisition.

After a strategic review of the Company's operations, with the goal of increasing shareholder value, Pursuit (formerly "Viad Corp") entered into an Equity Purchase Agreement with TL Voltron, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Truelink Capital"), pursuant to which Truelink Capital agreed to purchase all of the outstanding equity interests held by the Company in its subsidiaries comprising the Company's former GES Exhibitions and Spiro reportable segments (the "GES Business"). During Fiscal 2024, the Company completed the sale of the GES Business to Truelink Capital (the "GES Sale") and relaunched Viad Corp as Pursuit.

The aggregate purchase price was $535 million, consisting of a base purchase price of $510 million, subject to customary adjustments for cash, indebtedness, working capital and transaction expenses, and a deferred purchase price of $25 million payable by Truelink Capital to the Company one year after the closing date (which was received by the Company during Fiscal 2025). We determined that the GES Sale met the criteria to be classified as a discontinued operation. Accordingly, we have accounted for the GES Business as a discontinued operation in this Form 10-K. All amounts and disclosures for all periods presented reflect only the continuing operations of the Company unless otherwise noted. See Note 5 – Discontinued Operations to the Consolidated Financial Statements (Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K) for additional information.

On December 31, 2024, in connection with the GES Sale, we terminated and repaid in full all outstanding obligations (approximately $393 million) due under our previous $500 million credit facility with Bank of America, N.A. as administrative agent (the "2021 Credit Facility") and all related liens and security interests were terminated, discharged and released. The repayment of the 2021 Credit Facility led to the termination of the related interest rate cap, which managed our exposure to interest rate increases on $300 million in SOFR-based borrowings under the 2021 Credit Facility. See Note 10 – Derivative to the Consolidated Financial Statements (Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K) for additional information.

During Fiscal 2025, we entered into and subsequently amended a credit agreement (the "2025 Credit Agreement"), along with several wholly-owned subsidiaries as co-borrowers. The 2025 Credit Agreement provides for a $300 million revolving credit facility (the "2025 Revolving Credit Facility"), with a maturity of September 25, 2030. Proceeds from the 2025 Revolving Credit Facility are expected to provide us with additional funds for operations, growth initiatives, acquisitions and other general corporate purposes. See Note 9 – Debt and Finance Lease Obligations to the Consolidated Financial Statements (Part II, Item 8 of this Form 10-K) for additional information.

paragraphs: Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. ("Pursuit") 為一間全球性旅遊與休閒產業公司，擁有並營運一系列令人難忘的旅遊體驗，位於美國 ("U.S."), 加拿大、冰島及哥斯達黎加等知名旅遊勝地。我們的高階休閒體驗包括 17 項世界級的觀光景點及 29 間獨特的旅館，並結合餐飲、零售與交通服務，使遊客得以探索並與壯麗的國家公園及知名國際旅遊地點建立連結。本公司戰略方向為透過聚焦於更新、改善與擴充我們的難忘且啟發人心的體驗組合，來擴大並提升我們在全球知名地點的卓越體驗組合。我們的遊客來自主要市場，包括美國、加拿大、亞太地區、西歐及中美洲。
我們以合併基礎進行管理，用以評估績效並做出營運決策。因此，我們在本 Form 10-K 中被視為單一營運分部。請參閱第 19 註 – 分部資訊（Part II, Item 8 本 Form 10-K 的合併財務報表）以取得更多資訊。
我們所提供的體驗依地理區域分為 "組合" 進行分組與行銷。以下資訊描述我們的組合及所提供的體驗。
我們擁有並營運位於加拿大落基山脈的觀光與休閒體驗。重點包括班夫與賈斯珀國家公園的風景湖遊船、班夫纜車提供的山頂視野、科羅拉多冰川的冰川探險（含科羅拉多冰川冒險及科羅拉多冰川天空步道）、金屬天空橋跨越深邃峽谷，以及賈斯珀天空纜車。遊客亦可於班夫、賈斯珀及沃特頓湖國家公園享受美食目的地、零售服務及旅館體驗。此組合進一步補充了觀光導覽體驗與交通服務。
我們擁有並營運包括野生動物觀賞、鯨魚觀賞及冰川遊船等觀光與休閒體驗，以及位於丹奈利與肯奈 fjords 國家公園及塔克基納鎮的知名旅館。從塞德沃與塔克基納的港口城市，到丹奈利國家公園的終點，我們提供一系列知名觀光景點與旅館，並搭配美食與零售服務。
我們擁有並營運位於冰川國家公園周圍的觀光與休閒體驗。體驗包括導覽釣魚與河川獨木舟遊覽、住宿服務，以及美食與零售服務，皆旨在讓遊客體驗蒙大拿州壯麗的山脈風景。住宿包括由 Great Northern Railroad 所建的歷史旅館，至冰川國家公園邊緣的簡易小屋與露營車營地，以及旅館。

Flyover 是一種令人驚嘆與感動的沉浸式體驗，透過令人興奮的飛行旅程，將遊客帶入世界最壯麗的地點。此設施利用飛行動態座椅，設計為俯衝、俯衝與轉彎，讓遊客感受到飛行的感覺，同時搭配 65 英尺的球形螢幕，提供無與倫比的飛行體驗，穿越知名地點與自然風景。特別效果包括風、霧與氣味，創造難忘的娛樂體驗。2026 年 1 月 21 日，Pursuit 與 Brogent Technologies Inc. ("Brogent") 籤訂最終協議，以約 78.4 百萬美元現金（扣除交割後調整）買斷其所有 Flyover 設施（"Flyover 設施"），請參閱第 21 註 – 後續事件（Part II, Item 8 本 Form 10-K 的合併財務報表）以取得更多資訊。
Sky Lagoon，冰島令人驚嘆的海岸邊地熱水療中心，透過 Skjól 禮儀體驗，為遊客帶來根植於冰島傳統的健康旅程。Sky Lagoon 位於 Kársnes Harbour，Kópavogur，距離雷克雅未克僅數分鐘車程，擁有 70 公尺（230 英尺）的無邊際水療池，以令人驚嘆的日落、極光與黑暗天空視野為特色。此外，擴建的 Skjól 禮儀與 turf 房間於 2024 年開幕。

Tabacón Thermal Resort & Spa ("Tabacón") 為一間生態豪華旅館，佔地 570 英畝雨林，擁有兩處溫泉河景點，位於哥斯大黎加 Arenal 區域。Tabacón 提供 105 間客房、國際聞名的水療中心與特色美食體驗。Tabacón 的兩處溫泉河景點提供受保護的自然流動溫泉入口。背倚茂密森林，旅館蜿蜒的河流、瀑布與精心設計的泳池，提供寧靜、沉浸式的健康休閒體驗。
我們的體驗組合聚焦於三個主要業務線：景點（包括餐飲服務與零售營運）；旅館業（包括餐飲服務與零售營運）；以及運輸服務。

Banff Gondola 將遊客運送至加拿大艾伯塔省班夫地區 Sulphur Mountain 山頂，海拔超過 7,000 英呎，提供無遮蔽的加拿大落基山全景，並俯瞰班夫鎮與 Bow Valley。Banff Gondola 獲 2025 年 Trip Advisor Travelers' Choice 獎項。位於 Banff Gondola 山頂的 Sky Bistro 餐廳，在 2024 年 OpenTable 美國百大餐廳評選中位列前 100 名。
Lake Minnewanka Cruise 提供遊客獨特的觀光體驗，透過解說導覽的船隻遊覽加拿大落基山的 Lake Minnewanka 湖。Lake Minnewanka Cruise 的營運設施位於班夫鎮附近，包含船隻導覽、小型船隻租賃與私人釣魚行程。Lake Minnewanka Cruise 獲 2025 年 Trip Advisor Travelers' Choice 獎項。

Columbia Icefield Adventure 和 Ice Odyssey Experience 是探訪 Columbia Icefield 的 Athabasca 冰川之旅，讓遊客得以欣賞位於北極圈以南最大規模的冰與雪積累地點。遊客搭乘特別為冰川設計的大型 "Ice Explorers" 車輛，並搭配較小規模、更具親近感的 Ice Odyssey 體驗。Columbia Icefield Adventure 獲 2025 年 Trip Advisor Travelers' Choice 獎項。
Columbia Icefield Skywalk 是一處 1,312 英呎的導覽解說步道，包含 98 英呎的玻璃地板觀景區，俯瞰位於加拿大艾伯塔省 Jasper 國家公園內 Columbia Icefield Adventure 景點附近的 Sunwapta Valley。

paragraphs: 於 2026 年 1 月 21 日，Pursuit 與 Brogent Technologies Inc.（"Brogent"）簽訂最終協議，以約 78.4 百萬美元現金出售其所有 Flyover Attractions（"Flyover Attractions"），並根據慣常的交割後調整條款（"Flyover Attractions Sale"）。有關更多資訊，請參閱本 Form 10-K 第二部分，第 8 項「合併財務報表」之附註 21 – 後續事件。

於 2025 年 7 月 1 日，本公司與 Inversiones Turísticas Arenal, S.A.（"ITA"）股東簽訂 "Tabacón Purchase Agreement"，根據該協議，本公司取得 ITA 全部已發行及流通股。ITA 為 Tabacón Thermal Resort & Spa（"Tabacón"）之所有者及營運者，為位於哥斯達黎加 Arenal 區域、佔地 570 英畝雨林的生態豪華度假村，擁有兩處地熱河景點。Tabacón 提供 105 間客房、國際聞名的水療中心及特色美食體驗。有關更多資訊，請參閱本 Form 10-K 第二部分，第 8 項「合併財務報表」之附註 4 – 收購。自取得日後，Tabacón 之財務結果已納入本公司財務報表中。

經過對本公司營運的戰略評估，目標為提高股東價值，Pursuit（原為"Viad Corp"）與TL Voltron, LLC，一家特拉華州有限責任公司（"Truelink Capital"）簽訂股權購買協議，Truelink Capital同意購買本公司在子公司中持有的所有股權，這些子公司組成本公司先前的GES Exhibitions及Spiro應報告分部（"GES Business"）。在財務年度2024年，本公司已完成將GES Business出售給Truelink Capital（"GES Sale"），並重新啟動Viad Corp為Pursuit。

總購買價格為535 百萬美元，包含510 百萬美元的基礎購買價格，扣除現金、負債、營運資金及交易費用的常見調整，以及Truelink Capital於交割後一年支付給本公司的25 百萬美元延後購買價格（於財務年度2025年收到）。我們判定GES Sale符合分部終止營運的標準，因此在本Form 10-K中，我們將GES Business視為終止營運進行會計處理。所有期間的金額與揭露資訊僅反映本公司的持續營運，除非另有說明。有關更多資訊，請參閱本Form 10-K第二部分，第8項「合併財務報表」附註5 – 終止營運。

114年12月31日，配合GES Sale，我們終止並償還所有現有義務（約393 百萬美元），這些義務為我們先前與Bank of America, N.A.（行政代理）簽訂的500 百萬美元信用融資協議（"2021 Credit Facility"）下的義務，並終止、解除及放棄所有相關擔保與抵押。償還2021 Credit Facility導致相關利率上限協議終止，該協議管理我們對2021 Credit Facility下300 百萬美元SOFR基準借款的利率上升風險。有關更多資訊，請參閱本Form 10-K第二部分，第8項「合併財務報表」附註10 – 衍生工具。

在財務年度2025年，我們與數家全資子公司作為共同借款人簽訂並後續修改信用協議（"2025 Credit Agreement"）。2025 Credit Agreement提供300 百萬美元的循環信用融資（"2025 Revolving Credit Facility"），到期日為2030年9月25日。2025 Revolving Credit Facility的資金預期將為我們提供額外資金，用於營運、成長計畫、收購及其他一般企業用途。有關更多資訊，請參閱本Form 10-K第二部分，第8項「合併財務報表」附註9 – 債務及財務租賃義務。

paragraphs: 本公司之營運及財務表現受已知及未知風險影響。因此，過去財務表現與歷史趨勢可能無法可靠地預示本公司未來表現。

本公司易受總體經濟條件惡化及地緣政治不確定性影響。本公司業務尤其對美國及其他營運市場之總體經濟條件波動敏感。全球或區域經濟條件惡化，或消費者對經濟條件惡化之擔憂，無論係因通貨膨脹、利率、匯率、或其他經濟或地緣政治不確定性、旅遊中斷、疫情、就業與失業率、股市波動、貿易政策影響包括關稅、信貸可取得性收縮，或其他動態因素所致，均可能導致消費者支出減少，特別是對休閒旅遊及相關景點之支出。消費者偏好在經濟衰退或其他可支配所得受影響時期，傾向轉向較低成本替代方案，這可能導致因旅客休閒旅遊之自願性支出減少而使營收減少。此外，在高通貨膨脹及相關高利率時期，本公司之營運費用及變動利率債務之利息費用將增加。這些總體經濟發展對本公司營運的額外影響無法確定，總體經濟條件惡化可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。

本公司業務之季節性使本公司在旺季期間特別容易受到不利事件影響。本公司業務之高峯活動為夏季，因本公司絕大多數收入係於第二及第三季取得。若在這些旺季期間發生不利事件或條件，包括天然災害如野火、颶風或火山爆發，或其他使本公司設施無法使用或阻礙旅客前往本公司設施所在地點之事件，本公司營運成果可能受到重大且不利影響。例如，2024年7月22日，賈斯珀國家公園因野火活動而關閉並疏散。此事件對賈斯珀國家公園在2024年旅遊旺季期間本公司旅館設施之訪客數、馬林湖遊船及 Columbia 冰川景點（包括 Columbia 冰川冒險及 Columbia 冰川天空步道）造成負面影響。

本公司營運於高度競爭且動態的產業中。景點及旅館產業之競爭主要由價格與服務品質等因素驅動。本公司可能受產業容量增加影響，導致全球或特定地區，或特定行程之容量成長超過需求。本公司在旅館及景點業務中，主要透過品牌知名度與聲譽、地點、客戶滿意度、景點與房間價格、服務品質、設施、住宿品質、安全、本公司取消政策及取得優先價旅館庫存量來競爭。部分競爭對手擁有較多財務與行銷資源，這可能使其能降低價格、提供更便利、服務或設施、在本公司現有旅館直接競爭地點興建新旅館、改善其設施或擴張與改善其行銷活動，所有這些都可能對本公司旅館吸引潛在旅客的能力造成不利影響，並對本公司營收與獲利造成重大且不利影響，同時也可能限制或延緩本公司未來成長。若競爭對手透過激進的低價策略爭取或維持市場佔有率，本公司可能被迫降低價格與費用以避免失去相關業務。若本公司無法有效預測並回應競爭對手對變動商業條件，包括新技術與商業模式，本公司可能失去市場佔有率，或對營運成果造成重大且不利影響。
此外，本公司之成功取決於品牌之強度與持續發展，以及品牌策略之有效性。未能保護或區分本公司品牌與競爭對手，或無法應對產業競爭與動態環境所帶來的挑戰，可能對本公司營運成果造成重大且不利影響。本公司營運成果亦可能因未能提供滿意之客戶服務而受到不利影響。
本公司有時亦與他人競爭收購機會，這可能限制合適投資機會之數量，或增加財產所有者出售給本公司之議價權，使本公司更難以在具吸引力之條件或符合本公司業務策略之條件下取得新財產。
